bra: Page facts hold (read live from the product page 2026-09-24): herr 40–47, khaki or black, 16 variants, `grov sula`, `en snabb sväng ut på altanen`, `efter veden`, `kaffet är klart`, heel strap, plush lining — and 489 / 978 kr is exactly half price.
BOF_2_1 reads the store terms right — statutory 14-day right of withdrawal, no invented guarantee, no Klarna — the 2026-09-21 finding applied in a new hub.
TR_1_1 (`Inte för snön.`) and the indoor-only ban (`never waterproof, snow, non-slip, outdoor`) protect against returns from buyers who expected an outdoor slipper.
Reviews verified live and dated, quoted verbatim; SP_3_H1/SP_3_H2 isolate proof type (review vs demo) on the same structure; CO_1_H1 keeps the same feet and stairs and changes only the slipper.
Store name never appears; no policy lines; GT_3_H1 correctly bans a Christmas claim.
missat: OB_1_1 opens on a question (`Finns den i 47?`) — a question cannot be true or false; the size range is the headline. Still in To be Reviewed — fix before upload.

CO_1_H1's opening row is 22 words of voice-over for a 0–2 s shot (`Nerför källartrappan efter ved glider de gamla tofflorna av …`) — unspeakable in two seconds; the caption already shortens it, so let the picture open and the sentence follow.

Body lines are shared across concepts: `Fodrad med plysch från häl till tå.` in 8 of 17, `Hälremmen håller den på foten i trappan och i hallen …` in 6, `Kliv i dem på en sekund – öppen foppatoffelmodell …` in 4 — the data will not know which idea sold.

SP_3_H1/SP_3_H2 copy "the account's winning structure" (skeptic price question → proof) without naming the winner or its numbers; the question hook is inherited, so it stays, but the parent must be named.

No VARIABELTAGGAR, no Memo, no `AI content:` line, no COPY CARD and no shot-level direction table — the brief format since 2026-09-21 (docs/os/BRIEF-REGI.md, `CS-KLART` 2.9/2.12); written 2026-09-19/20 so the direction table is a note, not an error, this once.
This product has no memory in the repo — the Feedback row in the hub is its memory.
regler: Hooks are declaratives: `Herr 40–47, khaki eller svart.` is the headline — never `Finns den i 47?`.
A video row carries at most three words per second: a 0–2 s row gets one short clause (or NO TEXT and the picture), never a 22-word sentence.

One proof line per concept — plush, heel strap and `kliv i dem på en sekund` each belong to one brief; the others get their own line — and every brief carries the 2026-09-21 format (VARIABELTAGGAR, Memo, AI content, direction table).
